summaryJa: FBIのFD-302面談記録。被面談者は職務に就いている期間や民間パイロットの飛行時間を報告したが、航空の専門家ではない。2026年のある日に、同行者（SA含む）とともに行動中、約16:04に10,000 ft MSL付近で5–10秒間、90バーストのRF検知があり、方位58度で観測するよう依頼を受けた。数分以内に被面談者はサーマル光学装置で58度方向を観察し、空中の黒い物体を確認して写真を撮影した。観測中にその右側に2個目の物体を確認し、追加の写真／動画を撮影。両物体は同じ速度で一緒に移動し、いずれも「ブラックホット」表示であった。視界外に出るまでの総観測時間は約5–10分。高度や速度は推定できず、山稜線上方にあり進行方向はSEで方位約58–62度と記録された。被面談者が現場での唯一の目撃者かつ光学装置の唯一の操作者であり、撮影写真は捜査官および担当SAに提供された。調査日・場所等は記載または秘匿。文書はFBIの資産で結論は含まない。
summaryEn: FD-302 FBI interview report. The interviewee stated tenure in his position and some private pilot time but has no aviation expertise. On a day in 2026, while with others (including an SA), at approximately 16:04 he was alerted to an RF detection at about 10,000 ft MSL lasting 5–10 seconds with 90 bursts; he was asked to observe bearing 58°. Within minutes he used a thermal-optical device to view 58° and observed a black object in the sky, photographed it, then observed a second object to the right and took additional photos/videos. The objects moved together at the same speed and appeared “black hot.” He lost sight of them when they moved out of view; total observation time was ~5–10 minutes. He could not estimate altitude or speed. The objects were above the mountain line, moving SE at approximately 58–62°. He was the only person at the location to see the objects and the only operator of the optics. Photos were provided to the agent/SA. Date/location details are redacted; the document contains no FBI conclusions.
